changelog:
## v1.9.37

- Checkout Header Default Off: Checkout header is now disabled by default ('no') to preserve existing landing pages without unwanted headings
- Transparent Checkout Container: Checkout section background defaults to 100% transparent with zero default padding/borders to integrate seamlessly with existing page designs
- Professional Summary Bar Redesign: Removed sticky/floating layout completely and engineered 2 clean, high-converting ecommerce designs (Modern Horizontal Bar & Structured Order Summary Card) with zero box-shadow
- Sleek Urgency Pill: Redesigned urgency countdown timer into a crisp, high-end badge pill
